jobs.title: Add help command to board CLI
jobs.request: Add a help command to scripts/board.mjs. `node scripts/board.mjs help`, `--help` and `-h` should print the usage block (the command list currently in the file's header comment) to stdout and exit 0. Running with no command should also print that usage, but keep exit code 2. An unknown command keeps exit code 2 and its error message, followed by the usage. Keep the usage text in one place so the header comment and the printed help cannot drift apart. Add tests in tests/cli.test.mjs.

jobs.title: Use Object.hasOwn for unknown-command check
jobs.request: In scripts/board.mjs the dispatch checks `!commands[cmd]`, so names inherited from Object.prototype (toString, constructor, hasOwnProperty, __proto__, valueOf) are not treated as unknown: they skip the 'Unknown command' message and either run or fall into the error handler with exit 1. Use Object.hasOwn(commands, cmd) so those names behave like any other unknown command (message + usage, exit 2). Add tests in tests/cli.test.mjs. Flagged as a follow-up by the builder and reviewers of j-20261015-001.

jobs.title: Add a list command to the board CLI
jobs.request: Add `node scripts/board.mjs list` that prints one line per job (id, stage, rework count, title) as an aligned plain-text table, newest last, and "No jobs." when the board is empty. Read-only. Put the row formatting in scripts/lib/board.mjs as a pure function with unit tests in tests/board.test.mjs, add a CLI test in tests/cli.test.mjs, and add the command to USAGE.

jobs.title: Pin line endings for factory files
jobs.request: Add a .gitattributes so *.md, *.json, *.mjs and *.html are stored and checked out with LF. Git currently warns "LF will be replaced by CRLF" for every factory/jobs file on Windows. Do not renormalise unrelated files beyond what the attributes require; npm test must still pass.

jobs.title: Commit factory records after each job
jobs.request: The orchestrator leaves factory/board.json and factory/jobs/<id>/ uncommitted after a job, so the next job fails the clean-tree check. Add a final step to claude-setup/skills/factory/SKILL.md: after `stage <id> merged` (and after parking a job as needs-human or failed), commit factory/board.json, factory/backlog.md and factory/jobs/<id>/ on main with message "factory: record <id>". Keep agents forbidden from touching these files.

history.note: Handle failures: validate/git switch/reset --keep/rework merge conflicts; fix approve-rollback re-staging needs-human; reword no-push note for pr mode
approver escalated: touches claude-setup/** (always-escalate); changes orchestrator git flow on main; /factory rework change beyond spec

jobs.title: Fix park message branch wording when validate fails
jobs.request: In claude-setup/skills/factory/SKILL.md, step 6 (Park for a human) always tells the user the repo is left on <mainBranch>. But when step 7's validate reports errors, step 7 skips the rest (including git switch <mainBranch>), so the repo is actually still on the job branch <branch>. The same is true if step 7's git switch fails. Fix the step 6 wording so the message names the branch the repo is actually on: <mainBranch> when step 7 completed its switch, otherwise <branch>. Keep the change minimal, keep step 6 to three lines or fewer for the user, and extend tests/skill.test.mjs to assert the new wording. Do not edit .claude/ (generated).

jobs.title: Close backlog items when a job ends
jobs.request: Backlog items stay `[~]` forever, even after their job merges. When `node scripts/board.mjs stage <id> merged` runs for a job whose source is "backlog", change that job's backlog line (the one ending in `(<id>)`) from `[~]` to `[x]`; on `stage <id> failed`, change it to `[!]`. Put the line rewrite in scripts/lib/board.mjs as a pure function (e.g. `closeBacklogItem(markdown, jobId, mark)`) that preserves CRLF/LF like `markBacklogItem`, and leaves the markdown unchanged when no line matches. `nextBacklogItem` must still pick only `[ ]` lines. Unit tests in tests/board.test.mjs, a CLI test in tests/cli.test.mjs, and update the format note at the top of backlog.md.

jobs.title: Add a history command to the board CLI
jobs.request: `/factory status <id>` is meant to show one job's history, but the CLI only has `show <id>`, which dumps raw JSON. Add `node scripts/board.mjs history <id>` that prints the job's id, title and branch, then one aligned line per history entry (timestamp, stage, note), oldest first. Unknown id exits non-zero with the existing "unknown job" style message. Formatting goes in scripts/lib/board.mjs as a pure function next to `formatJobList`, with unit tests in tests/board.test.mjs, a CLI test in tests/cli.test.mjs, and a USAGE line. Do not change SKILL.md in this job.
